existing_ability_contracts.Limber: Prevents paralysis and halves recoil and crash damage taken by the user from the ER recoil/crash damage paths.
existing_ability_contracts.Unburden: Doubles Speed after the user's held item is consumed or otherwise lost.
existing_ability_contracts.Poison Touch: Successful contact attacks have a 30% chance to badly poison the target.
existing_ability_contracts.Tough Claws: Moves that make contact deal 30% more damage.
existing_ability_contracts.Predator's Edge: Powers up biting and slicing moves by 30%.
existing_ability_contracts.Countercurrent: When the user is hit by a contact move, the attacker's Speed falls by 1 stage. If that Speed drop makes the user faster than the attacker, the user's next move gains +1 priority.

adaptive_ai.intent: Use Sneasler as a viable offensive combatant and conditional Earthquake bait ahead of Mega Toxicroak. If Sneasler is knocked out by Earthquake, the next Earthquake executed by the same opposing active Pokemon against Toxicroak while Duelist's Rhythm remains active receives the ordinary 0.75 repetition multiplier. Defender replacement does not clear the attacker's history.
adaptive_ai.suggested_trigger: Observed repeated Earthquake by the currently active opponent, sufficient field duration for bait and subsequent attack, Sneasler and Toxicroak available; evaluate known legal options and plausible damage. Never inspect the opponent's unexecuted choice.
adaptive_ai.suggested_decision: On a legal replacement opportunity prioritize Sneasler ahead of Toxicroak when the bait offers useful expected value. Allow Sneasler to fight normally and exploit White Herb plus Unburden after Close Combat. If Earthquake faints Sneasler, consider Toxicroak as next replacement and Mega Evolve at a legal opportunity. Do not force a sacrifice, guarantee a KO, prevent the player changing moves, or refresh the field.
adaptive_ai.expiry: Disable bait-specific preference if terrain has expired, been replaced or cleared, or will not last through the expected follow-up attack; reevaluate when opponent switches, changes move or a better legal option exists.
